# Torzon Market

> > Torzon is a leading darknet marketplace offering 20,000+ listings with post-quantum encryption, multi-signature escrow, and support for privacy-focused cryptocurrencies like Monero and Bitcoin.

Torzon Market is a darknet marketplace that has operated since September 2022, providing anonymous commerce with advanced security features including NIST post-quantum cryptography, PGP encryption, and multi-factor authentication. The platform supports multiple cryptocurrencies and implements dispute resolution mechanisms for secure vendor-buyer transactions.
